mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within the next 6 months, or SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >50% of quarters with YoY GDP acceleration > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the labor market adds > 200k jobs in the month following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 1% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is above 5%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >50% of instances where INDPRO growth is <-1% YoY and UNRATE > 5%, or the ISM Manufacturing PMI rises above 50 within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4% and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will suppress S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL > 3%, or the Fed cuts rates by > 50bps within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, defined as a 10% month-over-month decline, signals a weakening housing market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 5-day returns in >70% of instances where HOUST declines > 10% MoM, or housing starts rebound by > 5% within the next 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Steadily falling unemployment, defined as a 0.5 percentage point decline over the past 6 months, signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >50% of instances where UNRATE declines > 0.5pp in 6 months, or the labor force participation rate falls by > 1pp within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as a 50 basis point increase over the past month, signals a hawkish Fed pivot that will suppress S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 50bps in 1 month, or the Fed reverses course and cuts rates within the next 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending growth slows by more than 2% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a consumer-led economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth < -2% and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >50% of instances where RSAFS growth is < -2% YoY and UNRATE is rising, or retail sales rebound by > 1% within the next 2 months.
